citations.title: Klarna and Kohl’s team up to bring flexible payment options to U.S. shoppers  | Klarna International
excerpts: **New York, NY - October 29, 2026** \- Klarna, the everyday finance network, is now live at Kohl's, giving U.S. shoppers more flexible ways to pay online and in the Kohl's app.
